notes.title: 08/04/2020 "Stupid Dungeon" Patch notes
notes.content:
Introduction:
Hello everyone, based on the feedback from many players, this update has optimized the game and added some new game content.

New content:
1. The game has added a new level "虚名".
2. The game has added some new text annotations.
3. A new setting function has been added to the main interface of the game. This function adds a new button that allows the game to switch between full-screen play and window play.

Optimization:
1. Optimized the presentation of some materials and traps in the game.

Fix:
1. Fixed the abnormal playback of some music in the game.

Tips:
Updating the game will cause the loss of inherent archives.
(Unfortunately, this technical problem has not been solved yet.)
Players who want to experience new content, please update the latest version of the game to experience the new content.
If the player cannot update, please restart the STEAM client.

notes.title: 07/29/2019 "Stupid Dungeon" Patch Notes
notes.content:
Introduction:
Hello everyone, based on the feedback from many players, some content in the game has been optimized and some new game content has been added.

New contents:
1. The game has added a new branch level "火海".
2. The game has added some new text annotations.
3. The "A" "D" "W" "Space" keys can now also control the character's actions at the same time.
4. The main interface of the game has added buttons and interfaces for adjusting the game volume.
5. More save points have been added to the game to facilitate players to continue the game.

Optimization:
1. The appearance materials of the boss and some enemies in the game have changed.
2. The death time of the characters in the game has been shortened again.
3. The duration of the "Shura" level in the game has been greatly shortened, but the difficulty has been slightly increased.
4. The location of the traps in some levels in the game has changed.
5. In the final battle in the game, the boss has added a new skill (I personally feel it is very cool).

Fixed:
1. The problem of music overlapping in the "无尽" level in the game has been fixed.

Tips:
Updating the game will cause the loss of inherent saves.
(We are very sorry, but this technical problem has not been solved yet.)
Players who want to experience the new content please update the latest version of the game to experience the new content.
If players are unable to update, please restart the STEAM client.

notes.title: 11/07/2019 "Stupid Dungeon" Game Notice
notes.content:
Introduction:
Hello everyone, the game was originally planned to be updated between the 12th and 15th. Most of the new game content has been completed, but it may be delayed for some time before it can be released due to some reasons.

New content preview:
1. Add new levels in the game
2. Add new easter egg levels in the game
3. Optimize the game fluency
4. Diversify the operation buttons in the game

notes.title: 06/21/2019 "Stupid Dungeon" Emergency Repair and Updates 3rd
notes.content:
Introduction:
Hello everyone, this optimization will complete the save slot part in the game. And optimize the game.

Optimization:
1. The duration of the bullet screen in the "修罗" level in the game is slightly shortened.
2. The "修罗" save slot is added in the game. The "修罗" slot is for players who have advanced the game progress to the "修罗" level to quickly return to the "修罗" level (players who have not advanced the progress to the "修罗" level will not be able to use this slot to obtain progress, * The progress will be reset after updating the game).

Fix:
1. Urgently fixed the bug that the trap in the "禁闭" level in the game cannot fall.
2. Fixed the bug that the bullet screen fired by the "最终战" boss in the game sometimes has an angle deviation.
3. Fixed the problem that some traps in the game are in the wrong position when triggered.

Tips:
Please update the latest version of the game to experience new content.
If you cannot update, please restart the STEAM client.

notes.title: 06/21/2019 "StupidDungeon" Emergency Repair and Updates 2nd
notes.content:
Introduction:
Hello everyone, according to the feedback from many players, this update optimizes the existing problems in the game.

Optimization:
1. The HP of the "最终战" BOSS in the game is slightly reduced.
2. The buttons in the "主界面" and "关卡选择" interfaces in the game have added click sound effects.
3. The system resources occupied during the "最终战" in the game are optimized again.
4. In the "关卡选择" function in the game, two slots "觉醒" and "突破" are added for players to choose. The two slots of "觉醒" and "突破" are for players who have advanced the game progress to the "觉醒" and "突破" levels to quickly return to the "觉醒" and "突破" levels, so that players can more conveniently continue the previous progress when they enter the game again (players who have not advanced the progress to the "觉醒" and "突破" levels will not be able to use these two slots to obtain progress, * The progress will be reset after updating the game).

Fix:
1. Urgently fixed the bug that the upper and lower traps in the "轮回" level in the game failed to trigger correctly.
2. Urgently fixed the problem that the right side of the knife array in the "觉醒" level in the game could not cause damage correctly (the author tested it locally, but I am not sure whether it will work on the player side).
3. Fixed the problem that the number of bullet screens in the "最终战" BOSS in the game was too small when triggering skills.

Tips:
Please update the latest version of the game to experience new content.
If the player cannot update, please restart the STEAM client.

notes.title: 06/19/2019 "Stupid Dungeon" Emergency Repair and Updates
notes.content:
Introduction:
Hello everyone, according to the feedback from many players, this time we have optimized some content in the game, and fixed the existing problems in the game.

Optimization:
1. Greatly shortened the death animation of the characters in the game, and the waiting time for the rebirth score screen.
2. The normal clearance difficulty of the "修罗" level in the game is slightly reduced.
3. The "关卡选择" function has been added to the main interface in the game. Currently, there are two slots, "禁闭" and "抉择", to choose from. The "禁闭" slot is used to help players skip the text dialogue before the first level and enter the first level directly. The "抉择" slot is for players who have advanced the game progress to the "抉择" level to quickly return to the "抉择" level, so that players can experience the next content and multiple endings more quickly (players who have not advanced the progress to the "抉择" level will not be able to use this slot to obtain progress, * The progress will be reset after updating the game).

Fixed:
1. Urgently fixed the bug in the "修罗" level in the game that can avoid all traps by getting stuck on the leftmost platform.

Tips:
Please update the latest version of the game to experience new content.
If you are unable to update, please restart the STEAM client.
